description: Canonical test vectors for the SEP Anarchy Soroban contract (`contracts/sep-anarchy`). This file is the single source of truth for the contract's ABI: every error code, IC count, validation rule, wire field is documented and CI-asserted by the inline `test_vectors_consistency` test. Anarchy is the simplest of the per-type contracts: 3-scalar update wire payload, 4-IC update VK, 3-IC membership VK, no occupancy commitment, no quorum threshold, no admin set. Member count is informational only.
architecture_note: This contract is the per-type Anarchy contract — one of the eventual four (Anarchy, OneOnOne, Democracy, Oligarchy). The `group_type` discriminator is implicit in the contract address; there is no polymorphic `update_commitment` dispatch, no `group_type` field in storage, no type-confusion guard. Anarchy is the protocol's null case: no quorum threshold, no admin set, no occupancy commitment for member-count hiding. The 3-scalar wire payload is byte-distinguishable from Democracy/Oligarchy's 5-scalar shape, but per-type address discrimination renders this moot — chain observers see the contract address first.

error_codes.description: Numeric values of `Error` variants (`#[contracterror] #[repr(u32)]`). Per-type Anarchy contract drops everything tied to multi-type dispatch (UnknownGroupType, GroupTypeMismatch), 1v1 (OneOnOneImmutable, Invalid1v1Tier), Oligarchy (MissingAdminRoot, AdminRootMismatch, Reserved22, InvalidInitialMembership), Democracy v1 artifacts (MemberCountMismatch, MemberCountOutOfRange, DemocracyInputMissing), Democracy v2 (InvalidThreshold — no quorum), and the unreachable UnknownVkKind=16. The active set is 17 reachable variants.

vectors.name: Reserved3
vectors.note: previously Unauthorized; admin checks now use require_auth() which panics

vectors.name: AdminOnly
vectors.note: create_group in restricted mode rejects non-admin callers (caller != admin after caller.require_auth)

dropped_from_sep_xxxx.name: UnknownVkKind
dropped_from_sep_xxxx.reason: VkKind exhaustively matched in update_vk; the variant was unreachable

dropped_from_sep_xxxx.name: MemberCountMismatch
dropped_from_sep_xxxx.reason: Democracy v1 artifact; Anarchy member_count is informational and never enforced by the contract

dropped_from_sep_xxxx.name: MemberCountOutOfRange
dropped_from_sep_xxxx.reason: Democracy v1 artifact; same as above

dropped_from_sep_xxxx.name: GroupTypeMismatch
dropped_from_sep_xxxx.reason: no polymorphic dispatch in single-type contract

dropped_from_sep_xxxx.name: InvalidInitialMembership
dropped_from_sep_xxxx.reason: no in-circuit floor for Anarchy; the natural 'no witness, no proof' game-theoretic floor is sufficient

tier.description: Member tier index → tree depth → leaf capacity. The contract MUST reject `tier > 2` with `InvalidTier`. Tier capacity is the total slot space (cumulative-joins ceiling per Democracy §4.1's tombstone-permanence rule, inherited).

max_groups_per_tier.description: Cross-group cap enforced by create_group: per-tier active-group count must be < MAX_GROUPS_PER_TIER, else TierGroupLimitReached.
max_groups_per_tier.rule: GroupCount(tier) MUST be < 10000 at create_group; exceeded → TierGroupLimitReached

vk_kind_enum.description: Two VK kinds for this contract — smaller than sep-democracy's 2 (same shape) and sep-oligarchy's 3. Anarchy reuses the standard 3-IC membership VK at `create_group`, `verify_membership`, AND `deactivate_group` — no separate Create VK family because Anarchy doesn't need verbose binding (no occupancy_commitment to validate against the proof). Update VK is 4-IC, smaller than Democracy/Oligarchy's 7-IC.

vectors.name: Update
vectors.note: Anarchy v1 update circuit per existing keyset-v2/vk-update-{small,medium,large}.json. 3 wire-supplied scalars; no contract-supplied input (unlike Democracy/Oligarchy which supply admin_threshold from storage).

vk_kind_enum.ic_ordering_canonical: MUST match the existing v2 Anarchy circuit's allocation order. Pinned for cross-implementation reference.

create_group_validation.description: Per-call validation in `create_group`. Single-type contract — no per-type dispatch. No threshold (Anarchy has no quorum); no occupancy_commitment (Anarchy doesn't hide counts).
rules: group_id MUST NOT already be assigned to a live or inactive group; collision → GroupAlreadyExists
commitment MUST be a canonical Fr encoding (Fr::from_bytes ∘ Fr::to_bytes round-trip); non-canonical → InvalidCommitmentEncoding
GroupCount(tier) MUST be < MAX_GROUPS_PER_TIER (10000); exceeded → TierGroupLimitReached
if RestrictedMode is true: caller MUST equal Admin, else AdminOnly (caller.require_auth() runs first)
proof MUST verify under the membership VK at `tier` against the supplied (commitment, epoch=0) public inputs; failure → InvalidProof
proof_hash(proof) MUST NOT be in UsedProof storage; collision → ProofReplay

member_count_validation.description: member_count is informational only — the contract accepts any u32 value and stores it without validation. The v1 sentinel `0` means 'not tracked'. The contract NEVER updates this field after create.

domain_tags.description: Field-element domain tags used inside Poseidon hash inputs (prover-side; the contract is value-agnostic). Anarchy uses a subset of the cross-circuit registry (DOMAIN_MEMBER + DOMAIN_TOMBSTONE only — no DOMAIN_OCCUPANCY since Anarchy has no occupancy commitment).

unused_tags_from_registry.name: DOMAIN_COMBINED_OCCUPANCY
unused_tags_from_registry.reason: Anarchy has no occupancy commitments to combine

update_commitment_public_inputs_wire_for.description: Wire encoding of `UpdateCommitmentPublicInputs`. Single Anarchy variant. Three wire-supplied scalars; the verifier consumes a 3-public-input vector at proof verification — no contract-supplied threshold (unlike Democracy/Oligarchy). Byte-distinguishable from Democracy/Oligarchy on the wire (3 vs 5 scalars), but per-type address discrimination renders this moot.
update_commitment_public_inputs_wire_for.vk_kind: Update (4 IC points: base + 3 public inputs)
canonical_encoding_rules: Every BytesN<32> commitment field MUST round-trip through Fr::from_bytes ∘ Fr::to_bytes; non-canonical encodings are rejected with InvalidCommitmentEncoding.
u64 epoch_old uses Soroban's native big-endian XDR encoding.
Public-input ordering for Groth16 verification is fixed: positions 1-3 from wire (in the listed order). No contract-supplied scalars.

storage_layout.description: Storage entries written by the contract. Per-type Anarchy means `group_type` is implicit in the contract address (not a stored field). `member_count` is preserved as informational (per option-A choice in the design doc).

fields.name: epoch
fields.rule: starts at 0, increments by 1 per successful update_commitment

fields.name: timestamp
fields.rule: ledger timestamp when this state was recorded

fields.name: active
fields.rule: false after deactivate_group; rejects update_commitment with GroupInactive

fields.name: member_count
fields.rule: informational only; supplied at create_group; NEVER updated by the contract. Sentinel value 0 means 'not tracked' per v1 sep-xxxx convention. The contract is value-agnostic to this field.

removed_vs_sep_xxxx.rationale: single-type contract; the contract address IS the discriminator

data_keys.name: Admin
data_keys.note: contract admin; required for update_vk and set_restricted_mode

data_keys.name: RestrictedMode
data_keys.note: when true, only the admin may call create_group; toggled by set_restricted_mode (admin-only). Default false.

data_keys.name: VK(tier)
data_keys.note: membership-circuit VK for tier 0/1/2; 3 IC points; reused at create + verify_membership + deactivate_group

data_keys.name: UpdateVK(tier)
data_keys.note: Anarchy v1 update VK for tier 0/1/2; 4 IC points. NO `group_type` second key — single-type contract.

data_keys.name: History(group_id)
data_keys.note: rolling-window history of past entries; capped at HISTORY_WINDOW=64; pruned FIFO

data_keys.name: GroupCount(tier)
data_keys.note: active group count per tier; checked against MAX_GROUPS_PER_TIER (10000) in create_group; decremented on deactivate_group

admin_entrypoints.description: Admin-gated entrypoints. All require admin.require_auth(); panic on unauth. There is no separate `set_admin` entrypoint — admin is fixed at __constructor.

vectors.name: update_vk

args.name: new_vk
args.rule: IC length matches `kind` (3 / 4); subgroup-valid; else InvalidVkLength / InvalidPoint

vectors.purpose: rotate Membership or Update VK at a tier — used for ceremony-rotation

vectors.name: set_restricted_mode
vectors.purpose: when restricted=true, create_group rejects non-admin callers with AdminOnly. Storage: DataKey::RestrictedMode (instance). Default value (key absent) is treated as false. Emits RestrictedModeChanged event for audit transparency.

queries.description: Read-only entrypoints. None require auth. All return Result<_, Error>.

args.name: max_entries
args.rule: tail-truncated to most-recent `max_entries`; if max_entries ≥ history.len() returns all entries

vectors.name: verify_membership
vectors.note: returns Ok(false) on bad proof rather than InvalidProof — read-only verifier semantics. Does NOT check state.active — post-deactivation attestations against the frozen final state remain verifiable.

vectors.name: bump_group_ttl
vectors.note: permissionless TTL bump for long-lived groups; bumps Group + History TTLs only, NOT UsedProof

epoch_invariant.description: Anarchy keeps Democracy's monotonic-by-1 epoch rule. update_commitment increments stored.epoch by exactly 1 on success.

proof_replay_protection.description: Global nullifier scope. The nullifier is sha256(proof.a || proof.b || proof.c) over the 384-byte uncompressed proof bytes. Scope is global per contract: the same 384 bytes used at any state-changing entrypoint on any group consume the nullifier.
rules: Once a proof's bytes have been recorded by record_proof, any subsequent entrypoint call with byte-identical proof.a||proof.b||proof.c is rejected with ProofReplay.

TTL of UsedProof entries is LEDGER_BUMP (~30 days). After expiry the same proof bytes can be re-used; long-lived groups require periodic state advancement to keep nullifiers alive (mitigated by recording fresh proofs at successful state-changing entrypoints — record_proof bumps UsedProof TTL, but bump_group_ttl does NOT touch UsedProof entries since they are keyed by proof_hash with contract-global scope, not per-group).
Pre-inclusion mempool replay is NOT closed by the contract-level nullifier — circuit-level operation tag binding would close that (deferred per design §11).

tests_to_implement.description: Inline test names that the `#[cfg(test)] mod test` block in `contracts/sep-anarchy/src/lib.rs` MUST cover. The `test_vectors_consistency` test loads this very file and asserts the contract's `Error` enum / tier mapping / IC-point constants match the values pinned above. Every other entry in this list maps 1:1 to a `#[test] fn` in the inline module.
